description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY.md §3.4 (ListDSNHandler's filter): the identity test user holds identity-level ego.dsn.admin but has NO dsns_auth record on dsn-{{PERMTESTID}} at all (that DSN's grants, set up earlier in this test group, were all for pmu{{PERMTESTID}}). Before this fix, ListDSNHandler's visibility filter only bypassed for session.Admin or identity ego.server.admin, so this user would have seen dsn-{{PERMTESTID}} filtered out despite holding what item 5 of the model calls an identity permission that unlocks every DSN.
